design: Single variable: reducer model. Same GLM 5.3 controller, same 4 branches, same bounds, same directive. Reference arm rp/glm53-best (Super reducer) reused from best pilot.

reducer_reliability.super_reference: accepted throughout best pilot except 7 degraded (HTTP 500/503) on flash-log trial

interpretation: Binary rewards identical (2/3 vs 2/3, same task pattern): no aggregator performance effect at this sample size.
Reliability differs: Mercury never flaked; Super flaked 7x under load. Mercury is the safer default reducer on reliability grounds alone.
MoA literature predicts aggregator dominance, but with n=1 per cell and a 2/3 vs 2/3 tie, this pilot cannot confirm or deny it.
